Campaign

Every operation carries forward. The two-week Arma Reforger cycle gives teams time to train, gather in-game intel and incorporate what happened into the next Sunday operation.

WEEK 01

Plan, train and gather intel

Tuesday · Planning
Campaign staff review the last event, decide what questions need answering and assign reconnaissance or shaping tasks as needed.
Wednesday and other available days · Training
Teams use their scheduled sessions to practise the roles and coordination they’ll need for the next event.
Flexible · Reconnaissance and shaping
RRC and DEVGRU teams set their own task times around member availability. If Alpha Team receives a shaping task, Alpha agrees when it can run it and reports the outcome in time for orders.
Sunday · Platoon training
The platoon trains together on the skills and coordination needed for the main operation.

WEEK 02

Issue orders and run the operation

Tuesday · Orders
Staff brief what the teams found, what remains uncertain and what changed in-game. If a team was spotted near the objective, the brief can reflect a possible move or reinforcement, with confirmed observations clearly marked.
Wednesday and other available days · Rehearsal and follow-up
Teams rehearse their assigned roles. Reconnaissance or shaping can continue on a day arranged by the tasked team if a question still needs answering.
Sunday · Main operation
The main operation runs 18:00–21:30 UK time. Its outcome and any unresolved leads feed the next planning cycle.

Campaign updates and released intel

Follow the story through published operation summaries and findings cleared for the public campaign page.
